What's new
Not set up yet
Run your own model on this device (e.g. Llama, Qwen, Gemma via Ollama in Termux) instead of — or as a backup for — Gemini. No API key, no rate limits, no "servers are busy," fully offline once the model is downloaded. The tradeoff: it uses this device's battery/RAM, and Termux has to stay open and running.
Ollama's default. Leave as-is unless you changed the port.
Whatever you ran ollama pull on — must match exactly.
Drawing pictures (Local Dream app)
Type /imagine a red fox in snow in chat and Blitz draws it using the Local Dream app on this phone. Open Local Dream, load a model, and leave it running. Free, no key, works offline.
Leave as-is unless you changed Local Dream's port.
Uses your Gemini key to turn "a cat" into a detailed drawing prompt.
Checks that Blitz can talk to the app.
Which AI should Blitz use?
With a backup set, if the first one fails (Gemini overloaded, or the local server not running) Blitz automatically tries the other before giving up.
Setup, once, in Termux
pkg install ollama
export OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*"
ollama serve &
ollama pull llama3.2:3b

The OLLAMA_ORIGINS line matters — without it, browsers block the connection. Keep Termux open (lock it in your recent-apps list, and turn off battery optimization for Termux) or the server stops and this falls back to Gemini.
A command console built into Blitz itself. It's not a real system terminal — a webpage can't run system commands — it only runs Blitz's own built-in commands. Type help to see what's available.
Blitz terminal — type help to get started.
>
Get Ollama running (one tap)
Copies the full setup command to your clipboard and opens Termux if it's installed — you just paste and hit enter there.
Libraries
Extra Python libraries that unlock more of what Blitz can do locally. Tap one to copy its install command and open Termux.
sympy
Real calculus, algebra & Pythagorean-style math solving, not just arithmetic.
numpy
Fast number-crunching — the base most other math/data libraries build on.
requests
Lets local Python scripts talk to the web, e.g. custom feeds or APIs.
pillow
Image editing/processing — resizing, filters, thumbnails.
yt-dlp
Download YouTube videos by pasting a URL. Termux-only — runs from the terminal, not inside Blitz itself.
beautifulsoup4
Reads and pulls data out of web pages — the basic tool behind scraping a site for info.
flask
Lets you run your own small local server in Termux — the first building block toward a real Blitz backend.
vosk
Offline speech-to-text that runs fully on-device — a possible workaround if your phone's built-in speech recognition stays broken.
gTTS
Turns text into spoken audio — lets a local script read things out loud.
opencv-python
Image/video analysis building block — frame comparison, motion detection. Note: there's no free tool that reliably "finds a video from a screenshot" — that needs a paid reverse-search API, this just gets you the local building blocks.
qrcode
Generates QR codes — a quick way to beam a link or file path to another device.
rich
Nicer, colorful output for your own Termux scripts — tables, progress bars, formatted text.
duckduckgo-search
Web and image search from a script, no API key needed — useful for building your own lookup tools.

Search & content providers
Free and quick: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → enable "YouTube Data API v3" → Credentials → Create API key. No OAuth, no review, just a key. Without one, YouTube results (including song/video searches) will clearly say they're not connected rather than silently failing.
Has a free plan with no card needed (about 1,000 searches a month when this was written). Sign up at tavily.com, copy the key from the dashboard, paste it here.
Gives Google's own results. Has a free starter allowance with no card needed. Sign up at serper.dev, copy the key, paste it here.
Keys stay on this device and are only sent to the service they belong to. Whether a search service lets a web page call it directly can only be checked on your phone, so use Test — it tells you straight away. Without a key, the Search tab still works through Wikipedia.
Gmail / Google
Not connected
Create one free in Google Cloud Console. Real limitation: Google OAuth only works from an http/https origin registered as authorized — it can't work if you just double-tap this file from your downloads (a file:// address). Google explicitly allows http://localhost (no HTTPS needed) as an authorized origin for local testing — so in Termux: python -m http.server 8000, then open http://localhost:8000/blitz.html, and add http://localhost:8000 as an Authorized JavaScript origin for this Client ID. That combination genuinely works.
YouTube — your real feed
Not connected
This is separate from the Gmail sign-in above and from the YouTube API key in the Voice tab — it's what makes the Feed's YouTube tab show recent uploads from channels you're actually subscribed to, instead of a generic trending chart. Needs the YouTube API key (Voice tab) set too, plus the same http://localhost setup Gmail needed. There's no way for any outside app to copy YouTube's own personalized home-page algorithm — this is the closest honest equivalent.
Instagram
Not connected
Important: Meta shut down personal-account API access in December 2024. Your Instagram account needs to be switched to a free Business or Creator account (in the Instagram app itself) before any of this can work — a personal account will fail no matter how correctly this is configured.
Real limitation: Opening the authorization page here is real. Finishing login (exchanging the code Instagram sends back for an access token) needs a server holding a client secret — that step can't be done safely from a single client-side HTML file. To actually use your own account without waiting on Meta's app-review process, add your own Instagram account as a "tester" on your Meta developer app — that skips review for personal use.

Your Space (Search tab)

Where your data goes
Blitz has no server of its own — nothing is sent to Blitz or Flambounds. Anything that leaves this phone goes straight from this browser to one of the services below. This list only counts visits; it never saves what was sent. Pictures and thumbnails load directly from the sites that host them.
What stays on this phone
Local storage
All memory, conversation history, mood, personality and settings live in this browser's local storage / IndexedDB on this device. Nothing leaves this device except messages you send to Gemini (when Gemini is used) and searches sent to the providers below.
